summary: Rangers announced they will investigate claims that Newcastle United owner Mike Ashley, through Sports Direct, has taken ownership of the club’s trademarks, including the “Ready” badge and mascot Broxi Bear. Documents filed with the UK Intellectual Property Office show the trademarks were transferred to SportsDirect.com Retail Ltd on March 25, following a £5 million loan to the previous board. The Rangers board said the matter is urgent, is reviewing all related contracts, and maintains it has had no discussions with Ashley.

summary: The White House announced that Adam Gadahn, a 36‑year‑old American who served as al Qaeda’s English‑language propagandist, was killed in a U.S. counterterrorism operation in January. The same strike also killed al Qaeda operative Ahmed Farouq and resulted in the deaths of U.S. hostage Warren Weinstein and Italian hostage Giovanni Lo Porto. Neither Gadahn nor Farouq was specifically targeted, and Gadahn had previously been indicted for treason and listed on the FBI’s Most Wanted Terrorists.

In his final known video, Adam Gadahn called for governments of Pakistan and Saudi Arabia to be overthrown .
He was raised in California and said he was of Jewish ancestry .
He converted to Islam in 1995, left U.S. in 1998 and joined al Qaeda, becoming a spokesman .

The wins advanced both players to the next round and revived hopes for Higgins of a fifth world title.
